scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Monthly salary of the worker must not exceed ₹20,000
Service period of the worker is fixed for one year
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of purchase of artificial limbs
Assistance is available to workers and their dependents who become disabled due to loss of vital organs in an accident
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to the rates fixed by Saket Hospital, Chandimandir (Panchkula) for artificial limbs to eligible workers or their dependents.
